duplicated city in two writing prompts; World Music Day prompt carried a random date
'chose to help instead of compete' corrected

Kaveri texts not widely known (Bharat Our Land, Gifts of Grace, Canvas of Soil, Vitamin-M, Twin Melodies, A Friend Found in Music, Words, Believe in Yourself) are examined only through their curriculum-stated themes, devices and original extracts; no invented plot details.
